'''Skustell''' was an [[Water/Legends|humid]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Skustell Cluster/Legends|Skustell Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EA" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]], a bipedal, humpbacked, amphibious [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Even after Skustell became part of galactic society, Ongree were not widely seen away from their homeworld.<ref name="NEGAS" />

During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] Skustell was rumored that a golden waterfall on the planet hid the entrance of a cave, which contained treasures.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Behind the Water Curtain}}</ref>
